_meta.purpose: Real, publicly addressable contributions by the subject DID. Kept apart from mock-activity.json so a synthetic record can never be mistaken for one of these.
_meta.verificationNote: Every entry carries a public URL that was recorded, not re-fetched in this session. verificationState is therefore partially-verified for all of them: the reference exists in the record, and this tool did not go and look.
_meta.thirdPartyNote: A third party citing this work in public is not an attestation event. Without a signed attestation, the strongest level any entry reaches is evidence-supported, and the reason is stated on the entry.
_meta.noNetwork: The importer that reads this file performs no network access.
